_note: Perceptual quality-metrics protocol, frozen before measurement.

dists.impl: pyiqa 0.1.13 archs.dists_arch.DISTS, cross-checked vs official DISTS_pytorch
dists.input: RGB uint8 -> float [0,1], NO resize, full frame, no crop
dists.official_crosscheck: DISTS_pytorch/weights.pt from dingkeyan93/DISTS (alpha/beta), abs tolerance 1e-5 vs pyiqa DISTS

musiq.weights: koniq10k (primary); paq2piq and spaq are sensitivity-only
musiq.input: RGB uint8 -> float [0,1], library's own multi-scale preprocessing, full frame
musiq.gt_reference: GT frames scored too, reported separately as domain reference

dover.impl: official VQAssessment/DOVER master, DOVER (full) not DOVER-Mobile
dover.weights: DOVER.pth from the official release / teowu/DOVER HF mirror
dover.input: the whole 100-frame clip, dover.yml defaults: clip_len 32, frame_interval 2, num_clips 3 (technical) / 1 (aesthetic), fixed sampling seed

aggregation.main_table: mean over 30 clip-level values (NOT the 3000-frame pooled mean)

runtime.note: shared A6000; benchmark numbers are the MIN of clean runs, spread reported
